structure.unit: Titling and Registration of Motor Vehicles

law.catch_line: Tractors and similar vehicles owned by sawmill operators
law.text:
No person shall be required to obtain the registration certificate, license plates, or decals for or pay a registration fee for any tractor, trailer, log cart, or similar vehicle owned by a sawmill operator when the vehicle is operated or moved:
Along a highway from one sawmill or sawmill site to another;
To or from a repair shop for repairs; or
Across a highway from one contiguous tract of land to another.
